comment: compute_weights at src/switch81.cpp:138 zeroes the weight of any step whose input jack is unpatched. A weight CV replaces the knob's value and is then multiplied by it, so the knob works as an attenuator once a cable is present. The invert behaviour is an exclusive-or of the invert switch and the invert jack's gate level. This model carries no Hold last value menu item, unlike the nine-output one, because it has only one output. All nine weight CV jacks carry the maker's second line 'Expects a 0-10V signal' and nothing more.
